text: dsh-babel 是一个面向 DSH 的互操作插件：它扫描 Claude Code、Codex 或指定目录中的 MCP 配置与斜杠命令文件，将 MCP 声明归一化后检查命令、服务状态和密钥条件，并生成兼容性报告。默认 dry-run 只报告；关闭 dry-run 并启用相应选项后，可把符合条件的 MCP 工具和有效斜杠命令注册到 DSH。命令支持常见参数占位符。适合希望复用其他编码助手生态配置的 DSH 用户；需要配置扫描根目录，MCP 服务凭据从运行环境或受限的 macOS 钥匙串映射解析。

dsh-babel brings Claude Code and Codex MCP configurations and slash commands into DSH. It checks declarations and reports compatibility; eligible tools and valid commands can be registered. Prompts accept arguments, and credentials resolve from the environment or a limited macOS keychain mapping.
我想让 DSH 读取 Claude 插件里的 MCP 配置。
能不能把 Codex 的斜杠命令放到 DSH 里用？
I want to check which imported MCP servers can run before enabling them.
dsh-babel 的功能「导入 MCP 服务」：扫描配置目录并归一化 .mcp.json 声明；启用注册后，将预检通过的 stdio 或 HTTP 服务工具接入 DSH。
dsh-babel 的功能「复用斜杠命令」：读取 Markdown 与 TOML 命令文件；启用注册后，把有效命令加入 DSH，并在调用时替换提示词参数。
dsh-babel 使用前须知：MCP 配置中的凭据引用会从进程环境解析；只有少数 GitHub token 名称可尝试从 macOS 钥匙串读取，其他凭据需由环境提供。（见 lib/secrets.mjs:17-42）
dsh-babel README · Introduction：<div align="center">

dsh-babel README · dsh-babel：**让 DSH 直接使用其他 AI 编码工具生态里的 MCP 服务器、插件与斜杠命令。** > 读它们已有的配置，而不是要求插件作者为 DSH 重新移植一遍。 [](README.md) [](README.en.md) [](https://github.com/Oliveryfaso/dsh-babel/actions/workflows/test.yml) [](LICENSE) [](https://github.com/Oliveryfaso/dsh-babel) [](https://github.com/Oliveryfaso/dsh-babel) [](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin) > dsh-babel 是社区维护的 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件，并非 DeepSeek AI 官方产品。

dsh-babel README · 它解决什么问题：插件作者要支持一个平台，就得为它单独写一份目录。一个典型的多平台插件会带六到八个这样的目录：

```
.claude-plugin  .codex-plugin  .cursor  .gemini-extension.json  ...
```

DSH 的那个格子通常是空的。dsh-babel 换个思路：**作者不用动，DSH 这边读他们已有的 `.mcp.json` / `commands/`**，把 N×M 的移植问题变成 N×1。

同时它做一件别家没做的事：**装之前就告诉你哪个能跑、哪个缺密钥、哪个根本跑不起来**——而不是装上去之后静默失败。

dsh-babel README · 功能：- **发现**：扫描 Claude Code 与 Codex 插件目录下的 `.mcp.json`，以及两种斜杠命令文件（`.md` / `.toml`）；根目录可配置。
- **归一化**：把多种 `.mcp.json` 方言（带 `mcpServers` 包装的 / 裸顶层的 / Codex 专有键的）降成**一套中间表示**。
- **预检**：四类检查把"静默失败"变成"明确原因"——依赖命令是否在 `PATH`、守护进程是否在跑（如 Docker socket）、密钥是否可用、版本是否未固定。
- **兼容性报告**：把每个服务器归入「可用 / 需密钥 / 不可用」，每条都附具体原因。
- **命令注册**：把发现到的斜杠命令注册进 DSH，支持 `{{args}}` / `$ARGUMENTS` / `$1` 参数替换。
- **MCP 注册**：连上 stdio 或 streamable-http 服务器，用 DSH 自己的 `createMcpToolDefinition` 注册工具。
- **密钥解析**：`process.env` 优先，其次 macOS 钥匙串的**白名单**（仅 GitHub token 家族）——绝不无差别翻钥匙串。
- **展示元数据**：`locale/` 文案与图标，配置项由 schemastery schema 声明，设置界面可渲染。
dsh-babel README · 安装：```bash
dsh-babel README · 从 GitHub：plugin_manager install_bundle github:Oliveryfaso/dsh-babel

dsh-babel README · 或本地目录：plugin_manager install_bundle /绝对/路径/dsh-babel
```

也可以在 DSH Desktop 里走 **设置 → 插件 → 添加插件**，填入仓库地址或本地路径。

安装后默认 **dry-run**：只在日志里打印兼容性报告，**不注册任何东西**。

dsh-babel README · 配置：配置项由 schemastery schema 声明，因此会出现在 **设置 → 插件 → dsh-babel** 的配置界面里：

| 配置项 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `roots` | `[]` | 扫描根目录；字符串路径或 `{ source, path }`。留空时使用默认的 Claude / Codex 插件目录 |
| `dryRun` | `true` | 只报告，不注册。要真正注册必须先设为 `false` |
| `logReport` | `true` | 把兼容性报告打印到日志 |
| `registerCommands` | `false` | 注册发现到的斜杠命令（需 `dryRun: false`） |
| `registerMcp` | `false` | 注册预检通过（`severity: ok`）的 MCP 服务器（需 `dryRun: false`） |

开启真注册：

dsh-babel README · 配置：```yaml
config:
  dryRun: false
  registerCommands: true
  registerMcp: true

dsh-babel README · 兼容矩阵（诚实版）：| 外部形态 | 覆盖 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| MCP `.mcp.json`（stdio） | ✅ 高 | 免密钥、依赖命令存在的，基本可用 |
| MCP `.mcp.json`（http/sse） | ✅ 高 | 依赖 bearer token 的会标「需密钥」 |
| MCP（依赖宿主运行时变量） | ⚠️ 有损 | `CODEX_*` / `CLAUDE_*` 等对方宿主注入的变量，DSH 没有，标为不可用 |
| MCP（OAuth） | ❌ 无对应 | `oauth_resource` 等 DSH 无等价物，丢弃并告知 |
| 技能 `skills/*/SKILL.md` | ✅ 高 | 格式统一（由 skills-manager 等已有实现覆盖） |
| 斜杠命令 `commands/*` | ✅ 已实现 | 发现 + 归一化 + 报告 + 注册 |
| Hooks | ⚠️ 有损 | DSH 仅 7 个点、仅 command handler |
| 子代理 `agents/*` | ⚠️ 降级 | DSH 无注册接口，只能降级为技能 |
| 插件 UI / mods | ❌ 不支持 | 必须用 DSH client 插件重写，无法移植 |

dsh-babel README · 报告长什么样：在一台装了 Claude Code 与 Codex 插件的机器上，首次加载会打印：

```
=== dsh-babel 兼容性报告 ===
文件: 28   服务器: 28
方言: {"bare":14,"wrapped":14}
传输: {"stdio":17,"streamable-http":11}

这就是这个插件的第二个价值：**明确告诉你为什么跑不起来**，而不是让用户以为「DSH 很烂」。

dsh-babel README · 目录结构：```
index.js              插件入口（apply + schemastery Config，Cordis 宿主插件形式）
cordis.patch.yml      bundle patch（插入 dsh-babel 一行）
locale/zh.json        卡片展示文案（标题 + 简介）
locale/en.json        same, in English

dsh-babel README · 开发与测试：```bash
npm test                  # 全部单测（75 断言）
node test/mcp-smoke.mjs   # MCP 注册冒烟（需本地 symlink 到 DSH 包 + 真实服务器）
node bin/dsh-babel.mjs    # 直接跑一次报告
```

dsh-babel README · dsh-babel：**Use MCP servers, plugins and slash commands from other AI coding harnesses inside the DeepSeek Harness.** > By reading their existing configuration, instead of asking every plugin author to port to DSH. [](README.md) [](README.en.md) [](https://github.com/Oliveryfaso/dsh-babel/actions/workflows/test.yml) [](LICENSE) [](https://github.com/Oliveryfaso/dsh-babel) [](https://github.com/Oliveryfaso/dsh-babel) [](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)
dsh-babel README · dsh-babel：> dsh-babel is a community-maintained DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin. It is not an official DeepSeek AI product.

dsh-babel README · The problem it solves：Supporting a platform means writing a directory for it. A typical multi-harness plugin ships six to eight of them:

```
.claude-plugin  .codex-plugin  .cursor  .gemini-extension.json  ...
```

DSH's slot is usually empty. dsh-babel inverts the direction: **their authors change nothing; DSH reads the `.mcp.json` and `commands/` they already ship.** That turns an N×M porting problem into N×1.

dsh-babel README · The problem it solves：It also does something nobody else does: **it tells you before you install which servers can run, which need a key, and which cannot run at all** — instead of failing silently afterwards.

dsh-babel README · Features：- **Discovery** of `.mcp.json` under Claude Code and Codex plugin roots, plus both slash-command formats (`.md` / `.toml`). Roots are configurable.
- **Normalization** of the `.mcp.json` dialects found in the wild (wrapped `mcpServers`, bare top-level, Codex-specific keys) into **one intermediate representation**.
- **Preflight** — four checks that turn silent failures into named reasons: command availability on `PATH`, daemon health (e.g. the Docker socket), credential availability, and unpinned-version drift.
- **Compatibility report** grouping every server as available / needs-a-key / cannot-run, each with its concrete reason.
- **Command registration** into DSH with `{{args}}` / `$ARGUMENTS` / `$1` substitution.
- **MCP registration** over stdio or streamable-http, using DSH's own `createMcpToolDefinition`.
- **Secret resolution**: `process.env` first, then a curated macOS keychain **whitelist** (the GitHub token family only) — never a blanket keychain sweep.
- **Display metadata**: `locale/` text and an icon; config options are declared as a schemastery schema so Settings can render them.
dsh-babel README · Install：```bash
dsh-babel README · from GitHub：plugin_manager install_bundle github:Oliveryfaso/dsh-babel

dsh-babel README · or from a local directory：plugin_manager install_bundle /absolute/path/dsh-babel
```

You can also use **Settings → Plugins → Add plugin** in DSH Desktop and paste the repository URL or local path.

It installs in **dry-run**: the compatibility report is printed to the log and **nothing is registered**.
dsh-babel README · Configuration：Options are declared as a schemastery schema, so they appear under **Settings → Plugins → dsh-babel**:

dsh-babel README · Configuration：| Option | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `roots` | `[]` | Roots to scan; string paths or `{ source, path }`. Defaults to the Claude / Codex plugin directories when empty |
| `dryRun` | `true` | Report only. Must be `false` before anything can be registered |
| `logReport` | `true` | Print the compatibility report to the log |
| `registerCommands` | `false` | Register discovered slash commands (requires `dryRun: false`) |
| `registerMcp` | `false` | Register preflight-clean (`severity: ok`) MCP servers (requires `dryRun: false`) |

dsh-babel README · Configuration：Enabling real registration:

```yaml
config:
  dryRun: false
  registerCommands: true
  registerMcp: true

dsh-babel README · Compatibility matrix (the honest one)：| External form | Coverage | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| MCP `.mcp.json` (stdio) | ✅ High | Keyless servers whose command exists usually work |
| MCP `.mcp.json` (http/sse) | ✅ High | Bearer-token servers are reported as needing a key |
| MCP depending on host-runtime vars | ⚠️ Lossy | `CODEX_*` / `CLAUDE_*` injected by the other harness do not exist in DSH — reported as unavailable |
| MCP with OAuth | ❌ No equivalent | `oauth_resource` has no DSH counterpart; dropped and reported |
| Skills `skills/*/SKILL.md` | ✅ High | A shared format (already covered by skills-manager and similar) |
| Slash commands `commands/*` | ✅ Implemented | Discovery + normalization + report + registration |
| Hooks | ⚠️ Lossy | DSH exposes 7 points, command handlers only |
| Subagents `agents/*` | ⚠️ Degraded | DSH has no registration seam; can only be lowered to skills |
| Plugin UI / mods | ❌ Unsupported | Must be rewritten as a DSH client plugin |

dsh-babel README · What the report looks like：On a machine with Claude Code and Codex plugins installed, first load prints:

```
=== dsh-babel compatibility report ===
files: 28   servers: 28
conclusion: available 14  /  needs-key 5  /  unavailable 9

That is the plugin's second value: **it tells you why something will not run**, instead of leaving you to conclude that "DSH is broken".

dsh-babel README · Layout：```
index.js              plugin entry (apply + schemastery Config, Cordis host-plugin form)
cordis.patch.yml      bundle patch (inserts the dsh-babel row)
locale/               card display text (title + description)
icon.svg              plugin icon

dsh-babel README · Development：```bash
npm test                  # all unit tests (75 assertions)
node test/mcp-smoke.mjs   # MCP registration smoke test (needs local symlinks + a real server)
node bin/dsh-babel.mjs    # run the report once
```
